page.overview:
Who is Elias de Corvo?

is a male human and one of the most famous blood hunters in the Claret Orders.

Elias is an older human man with a graying black beard and dark gray hair tied back in a ponytail. His face and forearms are heavily scarred. He typically wears a black leather trench coat and a red scarf.

Elias is a professional and disciplined man, with little patience for weakness and imbeciles.

In Elias's career with the Claret Orders, he successfully hunted many creatures, many of which left him with scars to prove it. In his later years, Elias became more focused on training new members of the order. At some point in his career he met Vess DeRogna, an archmage of the Cerberus Assembly.
